title: House of Pips Wiki
description: The player guide to House of Pips, the domino roguelike: every perk, supply and skill, the rules of the table, modes, progression and online play.
html:
House of Pips Wiki

House of Pips is a domino roguelike. You play Five-Up style dominoes against Rival, scoring whenever the open ends of the table add up to a multiple of five, and between hands you draft perks that bend the rules in your favour, alongside the maluses that bend them against you.

This wiki explains every rule, perk, supply, skill and mode in House of Pips, with the same names, rarities and numbers you see on screen.

Where to start #

  • New to the game? Read New player guide, then Domino rules.
  • Confused by a score? Scoring in depth walks through exactly how a play's points are added up, and in which order perks and maluses apply.
  • Looking up a card? Every perk has its own page in Perks, with the exact trigger, how copies stack, and worked examples.
  • Stuck? Try the FAQ and troubleshooting or the Glossary, or search with the box at the top of every page (press / to jump to it).

Browse the catalogue #

  • Perks: all 50 perks, from Common to Legendary, plus the 9 maluses.
  • Supplies: consumable items for the table, XP and Bone Bucks.
  • Skill tree: the permanent upgrades on the Table Sense, Fortune and House Rules tabs.

Learn the game #

  • Matches, hands and drafts: how a match runs, drafts, the hammer and the hand summary.
  • Game modes: Classic Table, Old School, All In, Custom and the rest.
  • Rival and table styles: who you're playing against, and Rival School.
  • Career, XP and Bone Bucks: XP, levels, skill points, Prestige and Bone Bucks.
  • Shop, Bone Boxes and cosmetics: the Supply Shop, Bone Boxes, cosmetics and the Slap Track.
  • Online play: playing a friend or a stranger through Steam.
  • Settings and accessibility, Controls, controllers and Steam Deck and Saving, Continue and Steam Cloud.

Spoiler-free

This wiki avoids story spoilers. Late-game surprises are left for you to find in the game.
